content.text: {"id": "mm6401a5", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed data from the National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System (NNDSS) for 2007–2011"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "incidence rates of 14 diseases were higher for AI/ANs than for whites"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "table 1", "q": "Number and incidence rate per 100,000 population for 26 selected notifiable diseases"}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "table 1", "q": "Number and incidence rate per 100,000 population for 26 selected notifiable diseases"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "table 1", "q": "Rate ratio: AI/ANs compared with whites"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "incidence rates of 14 diseases were higher for AI/ANs than for whites"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "surveillance/descriptive", "ev": [{"loc": "summary", "q": "Analysis of National Notifiable Diseases Surveillance System data from 2007–2011 indicates"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "For this study, CDC examined diseases that were notifiable during the study period and for which a minimum of 20 cases was recorded for AI/ANs."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Incidence rates were not calculated by ethnicity (i.e., Hispanic or non-Hispanic) for this report."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "which does not adjust the rates to control for differences in age, geography, and risk factors"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "the format does not test the differences in rates for statistical significance"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "A person's race in the surveillance system is based on self-reporting, regardless of ethnicity."}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
